kind.match: Match each classic to its kind.
kind.odd: Three of these are {value}s. Which one isn't?

rows.label: chess
rows.hook: is played on a checkered board where the goal is to trap the opposing king

rows.label: mahjong
rows.hook: is played with tiles bearing suits and symbols, often shuffled by mixing them loudly on the table

rows.label: rock-paper-scissors
rows.hook: is settled with a hand gesture thrown on a shared count, where each choice beats one and loses to another

rows.label: sudoku
rows.hook: asks players to fill a grid so every row, column and box contains each digit exactly once

rows.label: backgammon
rows.description: one of the oldest board games for two players
rows.hook: moves pieces around a track based on dice rolls, racing to bear them all off before your opponent

rows.label: ouija
rows.description: flat wooden board with numbers and letters
rows.hook: uses a pointer that seems to glide on its own to spell out ghostly messages

rows.label: tic-tac-toe
rows.description: game for two players played on a 3x3 board or a sheet of paper
rows.hook: is won by lining up three marks in a row on a simple grid

rows.label: Uno
rows.hook: is won by being the first to empty your hand, calling out before your last card drops

rows.label: checkers
rows.hook: is played by jumping over an opponent's pieces to capture them on a diagonal board

rows.label: boomerang
rows.hook: is a curved throwing tool famous for looping back to the thrower when thrown correctly

rows.label: dominoes
rows.hook: is played by matching numbered ends of tiles laid end to end

rows.label: Magic 8-Ball
rows.hook: answers yes-or-no questions with a reply that floats up inside a dark liquid-filled sphere

rows.label: Play-Doh
rows.description: modeling compound used by young children for art and craft projects
rows.hook: is a soft modeling compound kids squish and shape by hand, often sold in colorful tubs

rows.label: darts
rows.hook: is scored by throwing pointed sticks at a numbered circular target on a wall

rows.label: pinball machine game
rows.hook: keeps a metal ball bouncing among lit-up bumpers and flippers for as long as you can

rows.label: snakes and ladders
rows.hook: sends players climbing shortcuts or sliding backward depending on which square they land on
